result:
My verdict on DG2 round 5 (candidate `sha256:2f81c60a…8c46`) is **PASS**, with no new findings. F-DG2-220 is re-verified and closed, and nothing has regressed.

Before starting I confirmed the candidate: the ID recomputes to `2f81c60a…` (526 files) both in the candidate tree and in a clean clone at `96a3c293`. The two commits after `96a3c293` only add delivery metadata (the freeze manifest, `stages.json` and the assignments), none of which are in the manifest. I also confirmed DG1 still passes historical validation.

**F-DG2-220 (Low, REQ-DLV-034), now CLOSED_VERIFIED**
- **Unit runs:** `pnpm test` passed 15 of 15 runs, 640/640 each time:

  | Setting | Runs green |
  |---|---|
  | Node 24 | 8/8 |
  | Node 22 | 4/4 |
  | Node 24 under CPU load | 3/3 |

  The load was two busy loops on 4 cores, and a sampled third run averaged a load of about 8.7. In round 4 the same procedure failed once in 7 runs on Node 24.
- **The fix is genuine:**
  - The harness raises the wait timeout to 5 s and the test timeout to 20 s.
  - The guard test runs and passes in every run.
  - The test-file change removes no assertions.
  - The slowest p2-blank-forms test fell from 2121 ms to 411 ms.

**Checks run (all PASS)**
- **Build and static checks:** typecheck, build, lint, OpenAPI lint (161 operations), no-CDN, format and contrast all passed.
- **Integration**, run once with `LANG`/`LC_ALL` unset and once with `LANG=C.UTF-8`: 523/523 each time. That covers migrations 0001→0019 on a fresh UTF8 database, the DB guards, the contract test (161 operations), blank-text (25) and encoding (8).
- **e2e**, in EN and AR, in both locale settings:
  - The product stack passed 62/62 each time, including Define→G2 and Design→G3.
  - My acceptance stack passed 96/96 each time; its log shows `server_encoding UTF8`.
  - Axe found no serious or critical violations, error states included.
- **My database-encoding negative check (D-065):** databases created as `SQL_ASCII` and `LATIN1` were refused by all four `mth-db` commands (migrate, status, bootstrap, seed-dev) with exit 1 and the documented message. Nothing was created. `/readyz` returned 503 with `database: fail`, and a UTF8 control database migrated and reported ready. All 28 assertions passed in both locale settings.
- **Invisible-text checks (F-DG2-180):** my new spec `dg2-qa-blank-r5` tries invisible-only values in a charter field, in EN and AR:
  - a variation selector on its own;
  - a mix of other ignorable characters;
  - control characters.

  Each value is refused inline with the localized message. Nothing is sent and no charter is created. The API returns 400 `validation.blank` and the version is unchanged. An emoji with a variation selector is stored exactly as typed. A separate check of the shared text rule against the built package gave 17/17 expected results.
- **Validator:** `--register DG2`, `--pipeline` and `--reconcile` all pass, and reconcile lists my record as current.
- **Environmental residuals:** live registry (D-057), live CI (D-058) and Keycloak (D-049) are recorded as PASS on the offline/config surface, with the residual noted.

**Investigated, not counted as findings**
- My first integration and QA e2e runs failed in two old test files of mine, which rounds 2–4 had already retired:
  - the round-1 journey suite fails at G2 and G3;
  - the round-3 probe checks for the old defect, so it now fails when the product behaves correctly.

  Running the round-1 suite on the round-4 candidate failed in exactly the same way, so neither is a regression. I kept the first-attempt logs and excluded both files from the final runs, as in earlier rounds.
- During this round an implementer (BE9) edited two of my test-harness scripts, `with-pg.sh` and `qa-stack.sh`. The changes only make the test databases explicitly UTF8 and add an encoding log line; nothing is weakened.
- Other reviewers' commits arrived on HEAD while I was working. I didn't read their records, and my verdict rests on the candidate ID I confirmed at the start.

All data is synthetic. No business, Finance or IT approval is implied, and product gates G1–G6 never imply DG7. The disposable clones and scratch files have been removed.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- `reviews/DG2/round-5/qa-verifier.json` (review record)
- `reviews/DG2/round-5/qa-verifier.verifications.json` (F-DG2-220 closure)
- `test-evidence/DG2/qa/round-5/` (run logs)
- `test-evidence/DG2/qa/tests/round-5/` (my new tests: `encoding-refusal.sh`, `predicate-probe.mjs`, `e2e/dg2-qa-blank-r5.spec.ts`)
